message.content: {"note_claim": "The extended stay of Suni Williams and Butch Wilmore resulted from Boeing Starliner thruster failures and helium leaks, not toilet issues.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Boeing's Starliner spacecraft is docked to the ISS, where it has remained for months longer than planned due to unexpected thruster and helium leak issues.", "reason": "The article extensively documents that thruster failures and helium leaks were the cause of the extended stay, and makes no mention of toilet issues."}

parsed.note_claim: The extended stay of Suni Williams and Butch Wilmore resulted from Boeing Starliner thruster failures and helium leaks, not toilet issues.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Boeing's Starliner spacecraft is docked to the ISS, where it has remained for months longer than planned due to unexpected thruster and helium leak issues.
parsed.reason: The article extensively documents that thruster failures and helium leaks were the cause of the extended stay, and makes no mention of toilet issues.
